files.purpose: client camera page with motion and zoom panel

limitations: Raster dimensions do not establish Qt logical pixels, client area, DPR, Windows scaling or exact fonts.
Only visible default and camera-overlay states are evidenced; hidden hover, focus, loading, failure and empty states remain unknown.
Two visible client tabs do not prove the authorization contract; trusted business logic must enforce access.
The references do not prove NI protocol, acquisition timing, camera ownership, algorithm validity, units or calibration.
Reference images remain evidence only and are not compiled as full-screen backgrounds.

screenInventory.summary: Shared shell with camera preview, FV curve, peak trend and three result metrics.
Large preview and capture actions with device, image and media controls.
Camera page with a non-modal image-pan and zoom overlay.

primitives.rule: Persistent top status bar, left action rail, two client page tabs and a stacked content workspace.
Use a responsive two-column by two-row grid for preview, FV curve, peak trend and real-time results.
Preview and capture controls occupy roughly two-thirds of the workspace; camera configuration occupies roughly one-third.
Motion and zoom controls overlay the camera control column without reflowing the page and without implying physical camera movement.
The shared eleven-field acquisition form overlays the main workspace; this state comes from the supplied design contract, not a client raster.

templateCandidate.note: Reversible desktop preview candidate preserving the reference aspect ratio; not a product requirement.

components.responsibility: Display brand, device/acquisition state, data mode and application actions without claiming a connection the host has not supplied. Native Windows chrome owns minimize, maximize and close.
Expose only the main and camera pages in the client shell while leaving authorization to a trusted layer.
Render axes, labels, units, series and explicit simulated or invalid data state.
components.qtCandidate: Custom QWidget paintEvent or project chart component

components.responsibility: Present a host-supplied frame and camera state independently from measurement acquisition state.
components.qtCandidate: Custom QWidget or existing video surface

components.responsibility: Emit display pan and zoom intent without implying physical camera movement.
Collect the eleven documented acquisition fields and emit save intent only.

typography.name: font.ui
typography.note: Implementation fallback only; the source font family is UNKNOWN.

desktop.rule: Use expanding layouts and preserve chart, preview and primary controls within the desktop workspace.

minimumClientSize.note: Template candidate only; formal minimum size requires target-environment calibration.

implementationGuidance: Keep one shared shell and place the two client pages in QStackedWidget or the host router.
Use real controls and layouts; never compile the three full screenshots as the working interface.
Keep NI, acquisition, calibration, algorithms, permissions, filesystem writes and camera ownership outside UI constructors.
Do not display concentration as valid until the host supplies calibrated value and validity state.
Treat camera pan and zoom as display transforms unless an approved device contract states otherwise.
Page visibility is not authorization; validate client access in the trusted session or application layer.
Validate keyboard focus, labels, contrast and target DPI in the final application.

inconsistencies.description: The samples show connected device, active acquisition and calibrated-looking values, but no device, algorithm or calibration contract was supplied.
inconsistencies.handling: The template deliberately renders unconnected, simulated and uncalibrated states.

inconsistencies.description: The client references show only two top tabs, while no trusted authorization contract was supplied.
inconsistencies.handling: Expose the two visible tabs in this UI template and keep all real authorization in the host layer.

inconsistencies.description: The shared parameter drawer is required by the written design contract but is not shown in the three client rasters.
inconsistencies.handling: Implement it as a reversible contract-derived UI state and do not claim raster fidelity for that state.

confidenceSummary.EXACT: Reference file identity, pixel dimensions, hashes and visibly present pages, panels and labels.
confidenceSummary.INFERRED: Semantic component hierarchy, Qt choices, shared shell, camera overlay, parameter-drawer contract and implementation boundaries.
confidenceSummary.ESTIMATED: Colors, radii, proportions and candidate logical control sizes derived from raster evidence.
confidenceSummary.UNKNOWN: Exact font, DPR, client area, breakpoints, hidden states, permissions, device and algorithm contracts, real units and calibration.
